title: Wiemer header (v2)
description: A slim 72px bar with a plain wordmark left and a circle-arrow link right. Over a hero it is an accent-coloured bar on phones and fully transparent with light text on desktop, turning solid off-white once you pass the hero; it slides away while scrolling down and returns on scroll up.
notes: overlay variant is fixed and takes no space: put it over a full-window hero (wiemer-v2-hero)
solid variant is sticky and sits in the flow, for inner pages
the transparent desktop state uses the background colour for its text, so it wants a dark photo in light mode
